title: Comparison to Seva
subtitle: A cross-linked bridge between two recurring pressures
description: Gurbani returns dignity to remembrance, contentment, and the work in front of you. This bridge then carries into guru joins service to humility, honest labor, and offering rather than display.

heroSource.shortMeaning: As metal merges with metal, those who chant the Praises of the Lord are absorbed into the Praiseworthy Lord
heroSource.lifeApplication: Bring the mind back from the other person to the state of your own heart. Let the line meet the ordinary room before self-judgment starts arranging it.
